result.prior_version_note: An earlier version of § 1950.5 existed: it references 1985 and 2003 amendments, and subd. (c)(6) exempts security collected or demanded before July 1, 2024, when the one-month cap began. The provided documents do not state the earlier cap amounts. The rule's own note, citing the Berkeley Rent Board (D007, not in this set), says the earlier caps were two months' rent for unfurnished units and three months for furnished units.
